components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid for the
            city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^\d{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form:
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored. Rejected unless 8 to 15 digits
            remain after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: "^[-+()\\d ]+$"
          example: '0412 345 678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Must not be later than the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
          x-field-extra-annotation: '@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag. When true, allows creating an owner who shares another
            owner's last name and address instead of rejecting it as a household duplicate.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Assigned customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the upper-cased first three
                letters of the last name, a dash, then a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household (same last name
                and address, compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners sharing this owner's first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Assigned membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the
                last two digits of the registration date's year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Numeric membership level from 1 to 3, assigned on creation: starts at 1,
                plus 1 when an email address is present, plus 1 when the owner has no
                namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), capped at 3.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city via a fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' otherwise.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered today at the time
                this owner was created, signalling an unusually high daily signup volume.
              type: boolean
              default: false
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived duplicate-detection key formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId':
                the telephone reduced to its digits, the lower-cased email (empty when absent), and
                the household id. Two owners are the same registration only when these keys match.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal digits of the
                customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              readOnly: true
              example: 7
          required:
            - pets

      title: Problem Detail

      type: object
      properties:
        type:

          type: string
          format: uri

          title: Title

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600

          example: 500
          readOnly: true

          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'

          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors

      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:

          type: string

- **`AgeBand` util (new, 28 lines)** — a small, cohesive `AgeBand.of(birthDate, registrationDate)` returning `MINOR`/`ADULT`/`SENIOR` (or `null` when no birth date). This follows the existing `util` pattern (`Household`, `CustomerCode`, `CheckDigit`) so the derivation logic lives in a class with essentially zero surrounding complexity, rather than being grown into `Owner` or the mapper.
- **`openapi.yml`** — added `birthDate` (input) to `OwnerFields` and `ageBand` (readOnly) to `Owner`, so the generated DTOs carry both fields.
- **`Owner.java`** — added a `birthDate` field with plain getter/setter (each CC 1) and a `@Column(name = "birth_date")` so JPA persists it for the read-back on `GET`.
- **`OwnerMapper.java`** — one `@Mapping` line delegating `ageBand` to `AgeBand.of(...)`. MapStruct maps `birthDate` automatically by name; the interface method itself gains no branching.
- **`db/hsqldb/schema.sql`** — added the `birth_date DATE` column (the profile tests use runs `ddl-auto=none`, so the column must exist in the script).

No existing method's complexity was increased; the branching lives entirely in the new standalone util. Full suite is green (`BUILD SUCCESS`, 1/1 passing, including the new `coreDerivesAgeBand` check expecting `ADULT` for a 1990 birth date against a 2026 registration date).
